The '''Geonosian slicer module''' was a device for opening secure electronic locks. [[Risha Drayen]] provided one such module to [[Voidhound]] to unlock the secret vault located in [[Zone Zero]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
